# UsageDeck 0.6.2 beta 2

This follow-up beta makes TheClawBay setup and source selection more reliable.

## Fixes

- First-run setup now uses a detected `THECLAWBAY_API_KEY` environment variable automatically, so TheClawBay can refresh without requiring a duplicate key or an installed CLI.
- Selecting the TheClawBay CLI no longer checks unrelated API-key storage or reports the CLI source as unavailable when Windows Credential Manager cannot be read.
